Command.Comment: RAGIN CORE /etc/ragin and cert metadata (no secrets)

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
echo ETC_RAGIN_TREE
if [ -d /etc/ragin ]; then
  find /etc/ragin -maxdepth 4 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort
else
  echo DIR_MISSING=/etc/ragin
fi
echo ETC_RAGIN_TLS_DIRS
for d in /etc/ragin/tls /etc/ragin/certs /etc/ragin/keys; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    echo DIR=$d
    find "$d" -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | head -n 200
  else
    echo DIR_MISSING=$d
  fi
done
echo ENV_VALUES
if [ -f /etc/ragin/server.env ]; then
  echo FILE=/etc/ragin/server.env
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    key="${line%%=*}"
    case "$key" in
      RAGIN_LLM_API_KEY|RAGIN_PROVIDER_SECRET|RAGIN_EAIC_SECRET|RAGIN_SECRET|RAGIN_TOKEN|PRIVATE_KEY|KEY|SECRET|CREDENTIAL)
        echo "REDACTED_KEY=$key"
        ;;
      *)
        printf '%s\n' "$line"
        ;;
    esac
  done < /etc/ragin/server.env
else
  echo ENV_MISSING=/etc/ragin/server.env
fi
echo CERT_PUB_ONLY
for f in /etc/ragin/tls/server.crt /etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt /etc/ragin/tls/client.crt /etc/ragin/tls/*.crt /etc/ragin/tls/*.pem; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    echo FILE_PUB=$f
    openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -dates -ext subjectAltName,extendedKeyUsage,keyId,authorityKeyIdentifier -in "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo PARSE_FAIL=$f
    echo FINGERPRINT_SUM=$(openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo fingerprint_failed)
    echo SIZE_BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo stat_failed)
  fi
done
echo KEY_LIST_ONLY
for f in /etc/ragin/tls/*.key /etc/ragin/tls/*.pem; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    echo KEY_FILE=$f
    echo KEY_SIZE_BYTES=$(stat -c %s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo stat_failed)
  fi
done
echo DONE
